services.title: Display & Panel Repair
services.short: Cracked screens, lines, patches and flicker.
services.long: Cracked screen, vertical lines or dark patches? We inspect the panel, T-Con board and cables to find the real cause, then give you an honest repair or replacement quote.

services.title: OLED & Plasma TV Repair
services.short: Specialist repair for OLED and plasma panels.
services.long: OLED and plasma TVs need careful handling. We diagnose panel, driver and power faults on both technologies and give you an honest repair-or-replace opinion.
faults: Dimming, image retention or burn-in concerns
Lines, patches or no picture on OLED
Plasma buzzing, dark or no display

services.title: Backlight Repair
services.short: Dark or dim screen, sound but no picture.
services.long: Most dark-screen faults are failed LED backlight strips. We test, replace strips with quality parts and calibrate for even brightness.
faults: Picture visible only with a torch

services.title: Power & Dead TV Repair
services.short: TV not switching on or turning off by itself.
services.long: We trace power supply, standby circuit and protection faults, and repair or replace only what has actually failed.

services.title: Motherboard Repair
services.long: From logo-stuck TVs to burnt boards, we repair mainboards at component level wherever possible, saving you the cost of a full replacement.
faults: Stuck on logo or no signal

services.title: Smart TV & Software
services.short: Hang, slow apps, WiFi and firmware issues.
services.long: Android, Google TV, WebOS, Tizen and more: we fix software faults, update firmware and restore your TV to smooth working order.

services.title: Sound & Speaker Repair
services.short: No audio, crackling, distortion or speaker faults.
services.long: From a silent TV to crackling or muffled speakers, we test the speakers, audio amplifier and sound settings, then repair or replace only what has failed.
faults: No sound or very low volume
Blown speaker or audio board fault

services.title: HDMI, USB & Ports
services.short: No signal, loose or damaged ports.
services.long: Port replacement and signal troubleshooting for HDMI, ARC, USB, AV and antenna inputs.

services.title: Wall Mount & Installation
services.long: Secure wall mounting, new TV setup, channel tuning and clean cable management at your home.
